comparison.objective: Remove a stuck used coffee capsule, recycle it, select the matching new capsule, install it, and brew.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture bracing, extraction, selection, insertion, and button pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Used capsule recycled before the matching replacement is installed and brewing starts; other capsules must remain untouched.
comparison.reason: Tests extraction/replacement sequencing and visual matching, not notch fracture, hammer coordination, or recovery of generated metal fragments. Numeric pose/force tolerances are not stated.
